findings.title: Activate reserved fences when withdrawal metadata cannot fit
findings.cause: withdraw_original catches only logical-capacity refusal. The commit_metadata(candidate) that adds refusals, retirement event/slot and cleanup can reject the complete-image byte bound outside that catch. No withdrawal or scope fence has yet been committed.
findings.trigger: Admit source and recipient event, then set exact metadata serializer allowance to existing image +5 bytes; request sample withdrawal. Active reserved fields fit because true is shorter than false, but new normal cleanup metadata does not.
findings.observed: generic error; persistent origin withdrawn false; fence false and pending marker false; existing recipient status remains available.
findings.requirement: SPEC 16.12 reserved scope fence plus C03/C04/T03: metadata saturation must not consume reserved fence; fence/pending state precedes further use and survive without new alias/slot/cleanup allocation.
findings.suggested_repair: Handle complete-image refusal as well as logical-capacity refusal and commit existing original withdrawal plus reserved scope fence/pending marker before returning. Audit analogous direct retirement and load/materialization commits for the same serializer-bound ordering.
findings.limit: The independent reproduction uses a reduced serializer-bound projection, not an actual 32 MB saturated state.

findings.title: Recheck exact original measurement authority rather than a sibling origin
findings.cause: _group_allowed matches only human/sample/grant and accepts any matching SyntheticOrigin. A sibling measurement therefore satisfies current authority after the exact original measurement has disappeared.
findings.trigger: Fixture has two measurements M/N for one human/sample/grant. Stage M, reopen same fixture identity with M absent and N retained. Repeat before and after recipient admission.
findings.observed: first receive stores M and charges recipient; retry of previously received M returns already_stored; payload_status stays available; independent direct probe creates new synthetic preparation.
findings.requirement: SPEC 16.11/16.12 and A01/R01/R03: current source relationship and known generated origin must be available for each declaration/use; absent/unknown source authority holds and cached admitted receipt supplies no permission.
findings.suggested_repair: Resolve event measurement alias to its immutable original measurement and require the current exact fake human/sample/grant/measurement origin at admission, claim/checkpoint and use. Keep sample-wide monotonic restrictions independently durable.
